read_this_way.what: Classifies each scope-classified CoA into lead_trades rows (tag-matrix evidence + gated inference + the residential realtor append) and lead_products rows (tag + archetype bundle), then advances coa_applications.trade_classified_at. The classifier is the shipped dual-path module (Spec 84 §7); only the I/O moved to the runner (R-EH: the runner pages the source, reads the trades / product_groups lookups once and writes every target in one transaction per batch).

decisions.what: lead_products is replaced per processed lead: the e2 replace_keys delete and the e3 insert run in one batch transaction (R-EH (d) F), the same per-lead DELETE + INSERT the legacy step ran (classify-coa-trades.js:228, :241).

fences.const: key_prefix coa: on every lead_trades / lead_products write and replace key
